description: Get recent insider trading transactions for a stock from SEC Forms 4 and 5, newest first. Form 3 supplies initial ownership rather than a transaction. Type is the SEC transaction code: 'Buy'/'Sell' are open-market purchases/sales only, while Award, Exercise/Conversion (SEC code M: a derivative exercised or converted into shares, typically a stock-option exercise; filter value Conversion), Exercise (code X), Tax Payment, Expiration, Gift, Inheritance, Discretionary and Other are compensation or derivative mechanics, not conviction trades. 10b5-1 marks trades under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 plan ('-' = filing predates the 2023 checkbox). Date is the transaction day; Filed is the day its Form 4 or 5 reached the SEC, when the trade became public. Shares/Price/Value are as filed; Owned After is the post-transaction balance on today's split basis, per security kind and ownership form. Optional date-range, transaction-type and insider-name filters reach history beyond the newest rows.

fromDate.description: Only include transactions on or after this date, format yyyy-MM-dd (optional)

insiderName.description: Only include transactions by insiders whose SEC-filed name contains every word of this value, case-insensitive (e.g. 'Huang') (optional)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of transactions to return (default: 50, max: 500; values outside 1-500 are clamped)

offset.description: Number of matching transactions to skip before returning rows (default: 0)

toDate.description: Only include transactions on or before this date, format yyyy-MM-dd (optional)

transactionType.description: Only include one transaction type: Buy, Sell, Award, Conversion (SEC code M, option exercises included), Exercise (code X), TaxPayment, Expiration, Gift, Inheritance, Discretionary or Other (optional)

name: GetInsiderTransactions
title: Insider Transactions (Forms 4/5)
